description: Four sine oscillators arranged so that each modulates the frequency of the next, with the modulation added as a fixed number of hertz rather than as an interval.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the first oscillator's pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
How much the second oscillator modulates the one it feeds.
How much the third oscillator modulates the one it feeds.
How much the fourth oscillator modulates the one it feeds.
Chooses how the four oscillators are wired to one another, the three arrangements drawn beside the switch.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the oscillators at one volt per octave.
Moves the first oscillator's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ 1 allows.

outputs.text: The result of the modulation chain, right side.
The result of the modulation chain, left side.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
